name: @rsc-quiescent/alpaca-alert-watch-service
description: Read-only watch over both Alpaca paper loops' NDJSON decision journals, the kill switch's tripped-record, and alpaca systemd --user unit failures. Posts one batched [ALPACA-ALERT] message per run into the TTI Discord admin channel via turntide-islands' own Discord REST transport when anything new is found. Runs on its own 15-minute market-hours timer.
